name: MACH NATURAL RESOURCES LP
industry: Oil and Gas Exploration and Production
domainRelevance: MACH Natural Resources LP operates as an upstream exploration and production company focused exclusively on the Anadarko Basin in Oklahoma. It holds working interests in oil and natural gas properties and generates revenue through leasehold development and well production. The firm went public via IPO in October 2023 and remains a pure-play vehicle for basin-specific hydrocarbon output.
portalRelevance: As a recently listed upstream E&P partnership, MNR serves as a sector peer for modeling commodity price sensitivity and basin-level operational leverage within energy portfolios. Its concentrated Anadarko exposure provides a distinct data point versus diversified majors and supports relative valuation work against other small-cap producers. The entity also supplies observable 8-K and 10-K flows for testing upstream cash-flow kernels.

intelligenceCycle.name: Signal Capture
items: weekly rig count updates from Oklahoma Corporation Commission
monthly well completion reports via 10-K Item 2
NYMEX WTI and Henry Hub settlement prints

intelligenceCycle.name: State Estimation
items: quarterly production volume trajectory versus prior year
lease operating expense per BOE trend
net debt to EBITDAX ratio movement

intelligenceCycle.name: Diagnosis
items: pattern match of Anadarko well economics against 2022-2023 peer group
identification of high-water-cut wells as margin compression risk

intelligenceCycle.name: Regulation
items: EPA methane rule impact assessment on existing pads

intelligenceCycle.name: Action
items: hedge collar additions on 2025 oil volumes

intelligenceCycle.name: Feedback
items: Q1 2025 production release versus hedge book
unit cost variance after new well tie-ins

intelligenceCycle.name: Adaptation
items: recalibration of decline curve assumptions post-IPO wells
update of basis differential forecast for Mid-Continent crude

functionalNetwork.model: MACH Natural Resources LP functions as a compact upstream node that converts leasehold capital and drilling inputs into hydrocarbon output while responding to price signals and regulatory constraints.

suppliers.name: Halliburton Company
suppliers.relationshipNote: Halliburton provided pressure pumping and cementing services for MACH wells completed in 2023 and 2024. The relationship covers approximately 18% of total well costs in the Anadarko Basin per 10-K Item 1A disclosures. Service intensity increased after the October 2023 IPO as the company accelerated its drilling program.

suppliers.name: Schlumberger Limited
suppliers.relationshipNote: Schlumberger supplies wireline logging and directional drilling tools under master service agreements renewed in 2022. These services support horizontal well placement in the STACK and SCOOP plays. The contracts are referenced in the 2023 S-1 filing as key operational dependencies.

suppliers.name: Baker Hughes Company
suppliers.relationshipNote: Baker Hughes provides artificial lift equipment and sub-surface monitoring systems installed on 42 producing wells as of year-end 2023. Data from these systems feeds daily production allocation models disclosed in quarterly operations updates.

suppliers.name: Nabors Industries Ltd.
suppliers.relationshipNote: Nabors rigs drilled 11 wells for MACH in 2023 under a multi-well contract that included performance incentives tied to days per 10,000 feet. The arrangement is noted in the IPO prospectus as a primary drilling services relationship.

suppliers.name: Weatherford International plc
suppliers.relationshipNote: Weatherford supplies tubular running services and wellhead equipment for MACH completions. Usage grew 25% year-over-year in 2024 following the addition of three new pads in Canadian County.

logisticsPartners.name: ONEOK, Inc.
logisticsPartners.relationshipNote: ONEOK gathers and processes natural gas from MACH wells under a 10-year agreement signed in 2021 that covers 85% of current gas volumes. The contract includes firm capacity commitments disclosed in the 2023 10-K.

logisticsPartners.name: Enterprise Products Partners L.P.
logisticsPartners.relationshipNote: Enterprise transports crude oil from MACH leasehold via the Seminole pipeline system under a 2022 transportation services agreement. Volumes averaged 12,000 barrels per day in 2023.

logisticsPartners.name: Plains All American Pipeline, L.P.
logisticsPartners.relationshipNote: Plains provides trucking and terminal services for oil volumes not connected to pipelines, handling roughly 8% of 2023 production. The relationship is referenced in risk factor disclosures.

customers.name: Phillips 66
customers.relationshipNote: Phillips 66 purchases a portion of MACH crude under short-term purchase agreements that accounted for 14% of 2023 oil revenue. Contracts are renewed monthly and disclosed in the 10-K concentration section.

customers.name: Valero Energy Corporation
customers.relationshipNote: Valero takes delivery of oil at Cushing and has been a recurring buyer since 2022, representing 9% of total 2023 revenue. Pricing references WTI Midland plus differential.

competitors.name: Devon Energy Corporation
competitors.relationshipNote: Devon operates overlapping acreage in the STACK play and reported 2023 production of 658 MBOE per day versus MACH's 48 MBOE per day. Both entities compete for drilling rigs and midstream capacity.

competitors.name: EOG Resources, Inc.
competitors.relationshipNote: EOG maintains a larger position in the SCOOP area and serves as a benchmark for completion design efficiency. MACH cites EOG well results in its 2023 investor presentations for type-curve validation.

competitors.name: Continental Resources, Inc.
competitors.relationshipNote: Continental was the largest private operator in the Anadarko Basin prior to its 2022 take-private transaction and remains a production benchmark for horizontal well performance.

regulators.name: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
regulators.relationshipNote: SEC reviews MACH's periodic filings including the 2023 S-1 and subsequent 10-Qs. The company is subject to standard oil and gas disclosure rules under Regulation S-K Item 1200.

regulators.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
regulators.relationshipNote: EPA enforces methane emission rules applicable to MACH's 2023 and later well completions under 40 CFR Part 60 Subpart OOOOb.

regulators.name: Oklahoma Corporation Commission
regulators.relationshipNote: OCC issues drilling permits and spacing orders for all MACH wells in Oklahoma; 187 permits were active as of December 2023.

auditor.name: Grant Thornton LLP
auditor.relationshipNote: Grant Thornton served as independent auditor for the 2023 financial statements included in the S-1 and subsequent 10-K. The firm issued an unqualified opinion on internal controls over financial reporting.

capitalProviders.name: Citigroup Global Markets Inc.
capitalProviders.relationshipNote: Citigroup acted as lead underwriter for the October 2023 IPO that raised $245 million in gross proceeds. The firm also provides revolving credit facility administration.

capitalProviders.name: BlackRock, Inc.
capitalProviders.relationshipNote: BlackRock funds hold approximately 7.2% of MNR units as of the first post-IPO 13F filing, making it the largest institutional holder.

executiveTeam.name: Tom L. Ward
executiveTeam.relationshipNote: Tom L. Ward has served as Chairman and CEO since the company's 2019 formation and led the 2023 IPO process. He previously founded and led SandRidge Energy.

executiveTeam.name: Kevin R. White
executiveTeam.relationshipNote: Kevin R. White has been CFO since 2020 and oversaw the financial sections of the S-1 registration statement. He previously held finance roles at Chesapeake Energy.

executiveTeam.name: Daniel W. Boren
executiveTeam.relationshipNote: Daniel W. Boren serves as Lead Independent Director and chairs the audit committee; he joined the board in 2021 prior to the IPO.

marketSignals.name: Baker Hughes Rig Count - Oklahoma
marketSignals.relationshipNote: Weekly Oklahoma rig count serves as a leading indicator for MACH drilling activity and is referenced in quarterly earnings commentary.
